module_boundary_evidence.module: Rex adapter transport, target resolution, and notification submission
module_boundary_evidence.edges: server.status generation verification -> exact session inventory -> exact block inventory -> complete UTF-8 body write -> one independent send-key enter; snapshot -> official capture; observation -> foreground owner matching -> activity projection
module_boundary_evidence.resources: Rex server endpoint, service host_id and instance_id generation, Rex session, Rex block, terminal.write, send-key enter, official capture, terminal.process, terminal.program_status
module_boundary_evidence.gates: Rex publication requires a complete server/session/block endpoint; write completion is checked by UTF-8 byte count; write rejection, short write, or unknown write does not execute Enter; Enter is issued once to the same target and failure preserves WriteQueued without rewriting; service-change recovery requires KnownNotDelivered, stage BeforeWrite, operation server.status, native_code none, and the typed generation-mismatch marker; definitive absence is limited to exact session.list or session.list_blocks absence

module_boundary_evidence.module: Rex block current ownership and identity preservation
module_boundary_evidence.edges: candidate identity and Rex endpoint -> scoped current lookup -> binding publication validation -> current slot commit -> same Rex block current-owner replacement -> displaced current retained as previous -> active delivery projection; exact block absence -> maintenance Missing -> name retirement path
module_boundary_evidence.resources: BindingControlSet, IdentityBindingSlot, current and previous BindingValue, stable name, worker identity, agent session ID, Rex server/session/block endpoint, durable task and message ownership, pending effects
module_boundary_evidence.gates: Rex bindings require server/session/block; a Rex block has at most one active current owner; later successful publication unregisters only the displaced block owner; displaced identity and previous binding remain retained; no alternate block or transport is selected; block absence is not inferred from timeout, malformed response, service drift, or query failure; service refresh verifies the unchanged server/session/block target

module_boundary_evidence.module: Durable notification routing and narrow Rex recovery
module_boundary_evidence.edges: durable message -> selected current Rex binding -> exact block-owner validation -> notification attempt -> accepted or typed failure -> optional same-generation refresh -> one retry of the original durable message -> durable delivery receipt; channel inbound and timer/keepalive paths use the same narrow recovery hook
module_boundary_evidence.resources: durable message, wake binding, notification subscription, current binding control store, registration gate, delivery failure and acceptance records, channel-inbound envelope, timer and keepalive notification owners
module_boundary_evidence.gates: Rex delivery rechecks the current binding and unique block owner under the registration gate; stale cached transport is rejected; no fallback block or transport is selected; only a typed BeforeWrite server.status generation change enters refresh; refresh preserves server/session/block and retries the original durable message once; accepted or unknown post-write outcomes do not retry; notification acceptance remains distinct from receive and consumption

module_boundary_evidence.module: Rex activity monitoring and worker projection
module_boundary_evidence.edges: Rex observation -> complete foreground process identity -> program-status owner match -> valid state projection -> worker and master status views
module_boundary_evidence.resources: foreground PID, foreground process name, Rex program-status records, record owner PID/name, current Rex binding, AgentPresence, AgentActivity, worker status and master-wake projections
module_boundary_evidence.gates: foreground PID and name must both match; incomplete foreground identity remains unknown; records for another app do not prove Codex activity; blocked maps to waiting_user; working maps to busy; idle, done, error, and unknown states map to idle when the record is otherwise valid; no valid matching record remains unknown; conflicting current records remain unknown
